raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "look after"
  role subject "Oluwaseun"
  role object "the mail server"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?t
  measure start
  where match
    relation "look after"
    role subject "Oluwaseun"
    role object "the mail server"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
